biological.citation: ZMYND8 protects breast cancer stem cells against oxidative stress and ferroptosis through activation of NRF2 (PMID: 38488001)
biological.summary: ZMYND8 functions as a histone reader that reduces ROS and iron to inhibit ferroptosis in breast cancer stem cells through a positive feedback loop with NRF2. ZMYND8 increases NRF2 protein stability by silencing KEAP1 and recruits NRF2 to antioxidant gene promoters to enhance transcription, while NRF2 directly controls ZMYND8 expression.

biological.citation: De Novo ZMYND8 variants result in an autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder with cardiac malformations (PMID: 35916866)
biological.summary: Neuronal knockdown of the Drosophila ZMYND8 ortholog results in decreased habituation learning, consistent with a role in cognitive function. ZMYND8 is broadly expressed across all brain regions with highest expression in early stages of brain development.
biological.sample_size: 11 unrelated individuals with de novo or suspected de novo variants

biological.citation: De Novo ZMYND8 variants result in an autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder with cardiac malformations (PMID: 35916866)
biological.summary: Missense variants in the PWWP domain of ZMYND8 abolish interaction with Drebrin, while missense variants in the MYND domain disrupt interaction with GATAD2A, as demonstrated by yeast two-hybrid assays.

biological.citation: Targeting the histone reader ZMYND8 inhibits antiandrogen-induced neuroendocrine tumor transdifferentiation of prostate cancer (PMID: 40102673)
biological.summary: CRISPR-Cas9 screening combined with single-cell RNA sequencing demonstrated that ZMYND8-dependent epigenetic programming orchestrates neuroendocrine prostate cancer transdifferentiation. ZMYND8 binds to chromatin regions characterized by H3K4me1-H3K14ac modification and is stabilized by FOXM1 interaction.

biological.citation: ZMYND8-regulated IRF8 transcription axis is an acute myeloid leukemia dependency (PMID: 34358447)
biological.summary: ZMYND8 functions as a chromatin reader that directly activates IRF8 and MYC through their lineage-specific enhancers in AML. ZMYND8 binds to the ET domain of BRD4 via its chromatin reader cassette, which is required for proper chromatin occupancy and maintenance of leukemic growth.
biological.sample_size: in vitro and in vivo AML models with patient samples

biological.citation: The ZMYND8-regulated mevalonate pathway endows YAP-high intestinal cancer with metabolic vulnerability (PMID: 33932349)
biological.summary: ZMYND8 is upregulated by YAP and enhances intracellular de novo cholesterol biogenesis through the mevalonate pathway. ZMYND8 and SREBP2 drive enhancer-promoter interactions to facilitate Mediator complex recruitment and upregulate MVA pathway genes, restricting self-renewal of Lgr5+ intestinal stem cells.

biological.citation: Regulation of ZMYND8 to Treat Cancer (PMID: 33670804)
biological.summary: ZMYND8 is a transcription factor and histone H3-interacting protein that serves as a chromatin reader/effector. Increased ZMYND8 expression is linked to breast, prostate, colorectal, and cervical cancers with pro-oncogenic effects, while downregulation acts as a tumor suppressor in some contexts.

biological.citation: The endogenous retrovirus-derived long noncoding RNA TROJAN promotes triple-negative breast cancer progression via ZMYND8 degradation (PMID: 30854423)
biological.summary: The lncRNA TROJAN binds to ZMYND8 and increases its degradation through the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway by repelling ZNF592. ZMYND8 functions as a metastasis-repressing factor, and TROJAN-mediated degradation promotes TNBC progression.
biological.sample_size: multiple cell lines and clinical samples

biological.citation: USP7 deubiquitinates epigenetic reader ZMYND8 to promote breast cancer cell migration and invasion (PMID: 39128723)
biological.summary: USP7 directly binds to the PBP domain of ZMYND8 via its TRAF and UBL domains and removes FBXW7-catalyzed poly-ubiquitin chains at K1034, stabilizing ZMYND8 and promoting transcription of ZEB1 and VEGFA. USP7 protein levels positively correlate with ZMYND8 in breast cancer tissues.

biological.citation: ZMYND8 promotes the Warburg effect and tumorigenesis through c-Myc activation in pancreatic cancer (PMID: 40579459)
biological.summary: ZMYND8 is frequently overexpressed in pancreatic cancer and promotes the Warburg effect by directly interacting with and activating c-Myc transcriptional activity. ZMYND8 overexpression accelerates tumor growth in PC xenografts, which is reversible through c-Myc knockdown or glycolysis inhibition.
biological.sample_size: PC tissues, cell lines, and xenograft models
biological.significance: elevated ZMYND8 expression significantly correlated with poor overall survival
